title: Celestial Artist Goddess
description: A golden female figure with a radiant halo of spikes sits enthroned at the center, her chest opened to reveal a cosmic view of galaxies and stars. She holds an artist's palette in one hand and a spear in the other, with an open book on her lap, set against a swirling vortex of vibrant blue, purple, and gold with floating eyes and symbols.
prompt: A majestic golden female deity sits on a throne in the center of a swirling cosmic vortex of deep blues, purples and golds. Her chest is open revealing galaxies and stars within. She wears a radiant spiked halo, holds an artist's palette dripping with paint in one hand and a spear in the other, with an open book resting on her lap. Floating eyes and alchemical symbols appear in the swirling background, dramatic symbolic surreal style, painted with visible brushstrokes and dripping effects.
